title: Glue
description: Pistons can move chests, hoppers, and more. Use Glue to lock them in place — remove it with an axe.
body:
Glue

Move block entities with pistons — lock them in place when you don’t want them to move.

Glue allows pistons to push and pull supported block entities such as chests, barrels, hoppers, and more. This opens up new redstone possibilities, mobile storage systems, and compact automation builds.

To keep things under control, you can apply Glue to a block entity to prevent it from being moved. If you change your mind, simply use an axe to remove the glue — just like scraping wax off copper.

Features
Pistons can move supported block entities
Block entities retain their data when moved (inventory, names, etc.)
Glue item locks block entities in place
Axes remove glue quickly and intuitively
Designed for redstone builds and automation systems
Supported Blocks (v1)
Chests (including trapped chests)
Barrels
Hoppers
Droppers
Dispensers
Furnaces, Smokers, and Blast Furnaces
Crafters
Notes
Movement is restricted in situations that could cause issues (such as active use or invalid positions)
Some special or complex blocks may not be supported yet
Additional compatibility and features may be added in future updates
Requirements
Fabric API
Fabric Language Kotlin
